description: This file defines the TasksQuickCreate class, a PHP class extending QuickCreate, responsible for handling the quick creation view of 'Tasks' in the SuiteCRM application. It sets up various UI elements such as priority options, status options, time formats, and JavaScript interactions for the task creation form.

classes.name: TasksQuickCreate
classes.description: A PHP class managing the quick create interface for task entries in SuiteCRM, facilitating dynamic form rendering and JavaScript integration.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles form setup for creating a new task, including assigning dropdown options, handling time format specifics, and initializing JavaScript for form validation and submission.
